ItemID: In The Lonely Hour; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar classic hits than a contemporary pop album right now.
ItemID: 25; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could suit my occasional interest in newer pop, but I would choose a classic hits collection this time.
ItemID: Eagles: The Very Best Of; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Familiar classic rock in a hits collection fits my recent listening especially well.
ItemID: Neil Diamond All Time Greatest Hits; Title: Neil Diamond All Time Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: His melodic songs fit my interest in older pop and singer-songwriter collections.
ItemID: Number One Hits; Title: Number One Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist listed, I cannot tell whether these hits match the music I want.
ItemID: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This fits the nostalgic mid-sixties pop mood of my AM Gold listening.
ItemID: To Be Loved; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It might fit my interest in vocal standards from Cheek to Cheek, but I would want to confirm the artist and songs first.
ItemID: The Best Of Santana; Title: The Best Of Santana; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my classic rock interest, but the softer melodic collections appeal more this time.
ItemID: The Best of Bread; Title: The Best of Bread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Their gentle melodic sound fits my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and older singer-songwriter music.
ItemID: The Greatest Hits Collection; Title: The Greatest Hits Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not identify the artist, so I would skip it until I know whose songs it contains.
